panels.description: scope: all spend incl. unallocated — cost_facts for the period. Includes outcome, workunit, and unallocated entity types. Note: includes legacy v1 entities (project/goal/task/workitem) not shown in the Outcome Ledger below.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(cf.cost_usd), 2) AS value
FROM cost_facts cf
WHERE cf.timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Total Attributed Spend

panels.description: scope: outcomes that transitioned to done status within the time window

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT j.entity_id) AS value
FROM wms_journal j
WHERE j.entity_type = 'outcome'
  AND j.field = 'status'
  AND j.new_value = 'done'
  AND j.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Outcomes Delivered

panels.description: scope: mean of per-outcome attributed cost for all outcomes with cost activity in period

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(oc.cost), 2) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT cf.entity_id, SUM(cf.cost_usd) AS cost
  FROM cost_facts cf
  WHERE cf.timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND cf.entity_type = 'outcome'
  GROUP BY cf.entity_id
) oc

panels.title: Cost / Delivered Outcome (mean)

panels.description: scope: cost_facts rows with entity_type='' (no WMS entity) — the disclosed residual

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 2) AS value
FROM cost_facts
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND entity_type = ''

panels.title: Unallocated in Period

panels.description: scope: all usage_attribution rows in window, trailing 24h excluded (A5 sweep-lag). direct=temporal_join; inferred=temporal_join_lead_*; recovered=transcript/warmup/gap/synthesis; unallocated=no entity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN ua.method = 'temporal_join' THEN 'direct'
    WHEN ua.method LIKE 'temporal_join%' THEN 'inferred'
    WHEN ua.method IN ('transcript_focus_recovery','admin_warmup','gap_recovery','synthesized_outcome') THEN 'recovered'
    ELSE 'unallocated'
  END AS confidence,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM usage_attribution ua
JOIN token_ledger tl ON tl.message_id = ua.message_id
WHERE tl.timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND tl.timestamp < NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
GROUP BY confidence
ORDER BY FIELD(confidence, 'direct','inferred','recovered','unallocated')

panels.title: Attribution Confidence

panels.description: scope: outcome_true_cost_rollup, source_type='rework' — total cost of post-delivery corrections (remediates/reverts/addresses-limitation/fulfills-realization edges) attributed back to the original outcome, for the period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 2) AS value
FROM outcome_true_cost_rollup
WHERE source_type = 'rework'
  AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Rework Tax ($)

panels.description: Rework Tax ÷ Total Attributed Spend (cost_facts, incl. unallocated — same denominator as the Total Attributed Spend panel above).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * rework.c / NULLIF(tot.c, 0), 2) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS c
  FROM outcome_true_cost_rollup
  WHERE source_type = 'rework'
    AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
) rework,
(
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS c
  FROM cost_facts
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
) tot

panels.title: Rework Tax (%)

panels.description: scope: COUNT(DISTINCT outcome_id) from outcome_true_cost_rollup where source_type='rework' — outcomes that carried post-delivery correction cost in the period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT outcome_id) AS value
FROM outcome_true_cost_rollup
WHERE source_type = 'rework'
  AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Outcomes with Rework

panels.description: scope: all spend incl. unallocated — cost by work-type tag using canonical facet query with fractional weighting. (untagged)=entity with no work-type tag. (unallocated)=no WMS entity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(t.tag_value,
    IF(cf.entity_type = '', '(unallocated)', '(untagged)')) AS work_type,
  ROUND(SUM(cf.cost_usd * COALESCE(w.frac, 1)), 2) AS cost_usd
FROM cost_facts cf
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT etr.entity_type, etr.entity_id, etr.tag_id,
    1 / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY etr.entity_type, etr.entity_id) AS frac
  FROM entity_tags_resolved etr
  JOIN tags tt ON tt.id = etr.tag_id AND tt.tag_key = 'work-type'
) w ON w.entity_type = cf.entity_type AND w.entity_id = cf.entity_id
LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id = w.tag_id
WHERE cf.timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY work_type
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Work-Type Mix (attributed spend)

panels.description: scope: all spend incl. unallocated — cost by phase tag using canonical facet query with fractional weighting. Consistent cost basis with work-type mix.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(t.tag_value,
    IF(cf.entity_type = '', '(unallocated)', '(untagged)')) AS phase,
  ROUND(SUM(cf.cost_usd * COALESCE(w.frac, 1)), 2) AS cost_usd
FROM cost_facts cf
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT etr.entity_type, etr.entity_id, etr.tag_id,
    1 / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY etr.entity_type, etr.entity_id) AS frac
  FROM entity_tags_resolved etr
  JOIN tags tt ON tt.id = etr.tag_id AND tt.tag_key = 'phase'
) w ON w.entity_type = cf.entity_type AND w.entity_id = cf.entity_id
LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id = w.tag_id
WHERE cf.timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY phase
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Phase Mix (attributed spend)

panels.description: scope: all usage_attribution rows in window. Defensibility disclosure: what fraction of cost was directly observed vs recovered by which pipeline pass.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN ua.method = 'temporal_join' THEN 'direct'
    WHEN ua.method LIKE 'temporal_join%' THEN 'inferred'
    WHEN ua.method IN ('transcript_focus_recovery','admin_warmup','gap_recovery','synthesized_outcome') THEN 'recovered'
    ELSE 'unallocated'
  END AS confidence,
  ua.method AS method,
  COUNT(*) AS messages,
  ROUND(SUM(tl.cost_usd), 2) AS cost_usd,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct
FROM usage_attribution ua
JOIN token_ledger tl ON tl.message_id = ua.message_id
WHERE tl.timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY confidence, ua.method
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Attribution Method Mix — Defensibility Statement

panels.description: scope: outcome_true_cost_rollup, source_type='rework' — rework cost grouped by miss_class (code=shipped-to-bug, design=addresses-limitation, spec=fulfills-realization). Answers: where do post-delivery mistakes originate?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  miss_class,
  ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 2) AS cost_usd
FROM outcome_true_cost_rollup
WHERE source_type = 'rework'
  AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY miss_class
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Rework by Miss Class

panels.description: scope: outcome_true_cost_rollup, source_type='rework' — rework cost grouped by relation_kind (only taxable kinds ever appear here: remediates, reverts, addresses-limitation, fulfills-realization).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  relation_kind,
  ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 2) AS cost_usd
FROM outcome_true_cost_rollup
WHERE source_type = 'rework'
  AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY relation_kind
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Rework by Relation Kind

panels.description: scope: rolled-up cost (outcome_true_cost_rollup: direct + workunit + child_outcome + rework), not flat cost_facts — one row per outcome with cost activity in the window, including outcomes whose only activity was rework or child-outcome rollup. Rework Cost column isolates the source_type='rework' share. Confidence % = (direct + inferred) share of messages, from cost_facts/usage_attribution. Designed for invoice/budget review export.

properties.value: Blank means the outcome is abandoned (status=abandoned writes no resolution tag) or was otherwise closed without recording a resolution.

targets.rawSql:
WITH true_cost AS (
  SELECT
    outcome_id,
    ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 4) AS cost_usd
  FROM outcome_true_cost_rollup
  WHERE bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY outcome_id
),
rework_cost AS (
  SELECT
    outcome_id,
    ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 4) AS rework_cost_usd
  FROM outcome_true_cost_rollup
  WHERE source_type = 'rework'
    AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY outcome_id
),
msg_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cf.entity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.message_id) AS messages,
    SUM(cf.tokens) AS tokens,
    MIN(DATE(cf.timestamp)) AS first_activity,
    MAX(DATE(cf.timestamp)) AS last_activity
  FROM cost_facts cf
  WHERE cf.timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND cf.entity_type = 'outcome'
  GROUP BY cf.entity_id
),
conf AS (
  SELECT
    ua.entity_id,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ua.method LIKE 'temporal_join%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS confidence_pct
  FROM usage_attribution ua
  JOIN token_ledger tl ON tl.message_id = ua.message_id
  WHERE tl.timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND ua.entity_type = 'outcome'
  GROUP BY ua.entity_id
),
prod AS (
  SELECT etr.entity_id, MAX(t.tag_value) AS product
  FROM entity_tags_resolved etr
  JOIN tags t ON t.id = etr.tag_id AND t.tag_key = 'product'
  WHERE etr.entity_type = 'outcome'
  GROUP BY etr.entity_id
),
res AS (
  SELECT etr.entity_id, MAX(t.tag_value) AS resolution
  FROM entity_tags_resolved etr
  JOIN tags t ON t.id = etr.tag_id AND t.tag_key = 'resolution'
  WHERE etr.entity_type = 'outcome'
  GROUP BY etr.entity_id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(o.title, tc.outcome_id) AS outcome,
  COALESCE(p.product, '(untagged)') AS product,
  o.status,
  COALESCE(r.resolution, '') AS resolution,
  ma.first_activity,
  ma.last_activity,
  COALESCE(ma.messages, 0) AS messages,
  COALESCE(ma.tokens, 0) AS tokens,
  tc.cost_usd,
  COALESCE(rw.rework_cost_usd, 0) AS rework_cost_usd,
  COALESCE(c.confidence_pct, 0) AS confidence_pct
FROM true_cost tc
JOIN outcomes o ON o.id = tc.outcome_id
LEFT JOIN rework_cost rw ON rw.outcome_id = tc.outcome_id
LEFT JOIN msg_agg ma ON ma.entity_id = tc.outcome_id
LEFT JOIN prod p ON p.entity_id = tc.outcome_id
LEFT JOIN res r ON r.entity_id = tc.outcome_id
LEFT JOIN conf c ON c.entity_id = tc.outcome_id
WHERE COALESCE(p.product, '(untagged)') IN (${product:sqlstring})
  AND o.status IN (${status:sqlstring})
ORDER BY tc.cost_usd DESC
LIMIT 200
